## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich lasse mich davon inspirieren.** — [ikh LAH-suh mikh dah-FON in-shpee-REE-ren] — *I let myself be inspired by it.*
2. **Es liegt mir am Herzen.** — [es leekt meer ahm HEHR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart.*
3. **Ich brauche einen klaren Kopf.** — [ikh BROW-khuh EYE-nen KLAH-ren kopf] — *I need a clear head.*
